description: The biggest issue right now is that when a purchase request comes in from a branch nobody knows who is supposed to approve it if it is over 50k
user_story: As a Branch Manager, I want purchase requests over $50,000 to be automatically routed to designated high-value approvers, so that high-cost requests are properly authorized without approval delays.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Given a purchase request from a branch exceeds $50,000, When the request is submitted, Then the system automatically assigns it to the designated Senior Finance Approver.
2. Given a purchase request from a branch is $50,000 or less, When the request is submitted, Then the system routes it to the standard Branch Approver.
3. Given a purchase request over $50,000 is submitted, When it is routed to the Senior Finance Approver, Then both the submitter and the assigned approver receive an automated notification identifying who is responsible for approval.

description: People keep submitting requests without attaching the vendor quote
user_story: As a Procurement Specialist, I want the system to require a vendor quote attachment prior to request submission, so that all submitted requests are complete and can be processed without unnecessary delays.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Given a user is filling out a purchase request, When they attempt to submit the request without attaching a vendor quote, Then the system prevents submission and displays an error message indicating that a vendor quote is required.
2. Given a user is filling out a purchase request, When they attach a valid vendor quote document and submit the request, Then the request is successfully submitted and routed for approval.

description: The system does not send any reminder if an approval sits pending for too long
user_story: As an approver, I want to receive automated reminder notifications for pending approval requests, so that I can review and act on them promptly to prevent workflow bottlenecks.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Given an approval request has been pending for longer than the configured SLA threshold, When the system scheduled job executes, Then an email reminder is automatically sent to the assigned approver.
2. Given an approver receives a reminder notification, When they open the notification, Then it contains the request details and a direct link to the approval task.
3. Given an approval request is completed or cancelled before reaching the pending threshold, When the scheduled job executes, Then no reminder notification is generated for that request.

description: Need approvals to happen within 3 business days max
user_story: As an approver, I want pending approval requests to be completed or escalated within 3 business days, so that business operations are not delayed by approval bottlenecks.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Given an approval request is submitted, When 2 business days elapse without action, Then a reminder notification is sent to the assigned approver.
2. Given an approval request remains pending, When 3 business days have elapsed, Then the request is automatically escalated to the designated backup approver and logged for SLA compliance tracking.
3. Given an approval request is active over a weekend or public holiday, When calculating the 3-day limit, Then non-business days are excluded from the duration calculation.

description: Finance should see a simple dashboard of all pending requests
user_story: As a finance team member, I want to view a simple dashboard displaying all pending requests, so that I can efficiently monitor, prioritize, and process outstanding requests.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Given a finance user is logged into the system, When they navigate to the Finance Dashboard, Then a list displaying all requests with a status of 'Pending' is shown.
2. Given there are no pending requests in the system, When the finance user views the dashboard, Then a clear message stating 'No pending requests found' is displayed.
3. Given pending requests are displayed on the dashboard, When the finance user selects a specific request, Then they are redirected to the detailed view of that request.
